It omits the required speedup question and report/commit instructions. The missing-input test accepts any message containing “validation,” so it misses this contract gap.
items.suggestion: Return the actionable guidance for missing report files, including the expected input path, and assert that guidance in the preflight test.

items.body: The saved SHA-256 describes the working-tree bytes, but ordinary closure staging can transform those bytes. With CRLF JSON and `core.autocrlf=true`, Git normalizes the artifact to LF, so the committed report no longer matches its filename or recorded digest. A read-only `git hash-object --path` check reproduced this mismatch. Current tests write LF input and miss it.
items.suggestion: Exempt report artifacts from Git text conversion and applicable clean filters. Add a focused CRLF control that compares committed bytes and their SHA-256 against the input.
